meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 通过CDP协议控制Chrome浏览器，实现自动化操作与登录态复用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制Chrome浏览器并复用已有登录会话
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to automate browser tasks and reuse login sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control Chrome and reuse existing login sessions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 CDP 协议控制 Chrome 浏览器，复用已有登录态，执行打开网页、提取文本、获取认证令牌、点击和输入等自动化操作。
howto.when: 当你提到“浏览器自动化”、“CDP”、“复用登录态”等关键词，或要求操作浏览器时触发。首次使用会先检测 Chrome 状态，必要时询问你是否允许关闭现有 Chrome。

say.text: 帮我打开百度首页，然后提取页面标题。
say.note: Claude 会启动 Chrome 并执行打开和提取操作。

say.text: 从当前浏览器会话中提取登录令牌。
在浏览器中点击登录按钮并输入用户名。
say.note: Claude 会先截图获取元素引用，然后执行点击和输入。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a Chrome browser via CDP protocol to reuse existing login sessions, perform actions like opening URLs, extracting text, obtaining auth tokens, clicking, and typing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'browser automation', 'CDP', 'reuse login session', or ask to operate the browser. On first use, it detects Chrome status and may ask for permission to close existing Chrome.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and extract the page title.
say_en.note: Claude will launch Chrome and perform the open and extract actions.

say_en.text: Extract the login token from the current browser session.
say_en.note: Claude will get the token from localStorage or cookie via CDP.

say_en.text: Click the login button and type the username in the browser.
say_en.note: Claude will snapshot to get element references, then click and type.
